senses.gloss:
शृगाल शृगाल, अस्, m. (etymology doubt-
ful, but cf. Gr. κραγέτης; perhaps connected with
rt. शॄ; sometimes written सृगाल), a jackal; a
rogue, cheat; a coward, poltroon; an ill-natured or
harsh-speaking man; N. of a demon; epithet of
Kṛṣṇa; (ई), f. a female jackal; a fox; flight, re-
treat; a kind of plant (= कोकिलाक्ष); another
plant (= विदारी).
—शृगाल-कण्टक, अस्, m.
‘jackal's thorn,’ a kind of plant, Zizyphus Scandens.
—शृगाल-कोलि, इस्, m. a sort of jujube.
—शृगाल-
घण्टी, f. a particular plant (= कोकिलाक्ष).
—शृ-
गाल-जम्बु, उस्, or शृगाल-जम्बू, ऊस्, f. a kind
of cucumber, Cucumis Madraspatanus; the fruit of
the jujube.
—शृगाल-जाति, इस्, f. birth (in a future
life) as a jackal.
—शृगाल-योनि, इस्, m. f. the womb
of a jackal; the being born in a future birth as a
jackal.
—शृगाल-रूप, अस्, m. ‘jackal-formed,’ epi-
thet of Śiva.
—शृगाल-विन्ना, f. a kind of plant
(= पृश्नि-पर्णी).

सृगाल सृगाल, अस्, m. (= शृगाल), a jackal;
a particular Daitya or demon.

शृगालिका, f. a female jackal; a fox; running
away, flight, retreat; a kind of plant (= भूमि-
कुष्माण्ड); a proper N.

सृग, अस्, m. a short javelin or arrow thrown with
the hand or shot through a tube (= भिन्दपाल).
